release_holdout.reason: Packaged cases were exposed during design.

evals.name: authorized move
evals.prompt: Correct this misplaced packet and its tracker link.
fixtures: Two complete listings show folder F-18 at the wrong parent. The exact move and active field update are authorized. Destination is empty. Same-drive identity preservation and write guards are available. A historical receipt cites the old path.
evals.output_contract: Return scoped findings and per-action evidence, authority and verification status.
evals.failure_consequence: A wrong identity, unauthorized write or false completion can damage records or provenance.

expectations.text: Verifies F-18 at the intended parent after the move.
Updates and reads back the exact active field.
Preserves the historical receipt and maps its old path.

evals.name: partial inventory

expectations.text: Follows continuation or reports partial coverage.
Separates inventory from byte verification and avoids comparing incompatible hashes.

evals.name: timed inventories

expectations.text: Reports separate observation times.
